features.title: Game passes #1 프리미엄 차고 (premium vehicles + remote garage), #3 편의 패스 (50% shorter jail/respawn wait + phone 블랙마켓 앱), #4 과시 패스 (KO finish effects + custom plate + neon nickname) (GwangalliPasses)
features.extra:
## Extra rule for this feature
Prefer runtime hooks over edits: wrap functions of existing ModuleScripts when other code calls them through the module table (keep the original, call through), listen to attributes the existing systems set (e.g. a jail-until or respawn timestamp) and adjust them server-side, or add server-side checks around remotes you can intercept safely. If a behaviour truly can only be changed by editing an existing place script, write a minimal unified diff against the dumped script as patches/GwangalliPasses_<script>.patch with a Korean note on where to apply it — and keep the add-on working (degraded) without the patch.
features.research:
The owner and a teammate (Korean chat) decided to sell three Roblox game passes for this open-world life/crime game. Research everything they touch in the dumped place scripts (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user--/70cfab65-8cfb-5029-bbdf-07c69ae89ee1/scratchpad/bld/src + scriptlist.txt, add-ons in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user--/70cfab65-8cfb-5029-bbdf-07c69ae89ee1/scratchpad/v7src/gen__addons__zip__*) and in place.bin:
(a) VEHICLES: how a player's car is summoned/spawned today (phone UI app? '내 차 호출'? garage desk? GwangalliVehicles Spawn/Cars/Parked, GwangalliGameplay/Garage, Destination '광안정비소' at the 광안 오토 정비소), all remotes/functions involved, server checks, where the phone UI lives (find the phone LocalScript/modules and every vehicle-related app/button in it), vehicle catalog data (which models are hypercars/supercars/special vehicles: police/ambulance/taxi/etc.), ownership and purchase flows. Note another agent is concurrently building a dealership add-on in src/*/GwangalliCarDealer* (may not exist yet).
(b) JAIL / RESPAWN waits: arrest + jail time (Law/Police, Arms, KOSystem, Bump?), knock-out/death → hospital/ward wake-up wait (GwangalliGameplay/Health collapse, KOSystem.wardTarget), respawn timers; how each duration is computed/stored (attributes? module constants? per-player state) and where it could be halved for pass owners.
(c) BLACK MARKET: ServerScriptService/GwangalliGameplay/WeaponDealer (and any 암시장 NPC), its items (ammo, 방탄복, weapons), prices, purchase API/remotes, server validation (distance to NPC?), inventory/Arms integration.
(d) KO/KILL events: where a player knocks out/kills another (KOSystem, Arms, Health), which events/attributes signal 'A KO'd B', so a finish effect can be triggered for the attacker.
(e) LICENSE PLATES: how car plates are rendered (SurfaceGui/TextLabel names on car models, plate number source) and whether plates are per-owner; OVERHEAD NAME TAGS: existing BillboardGui nameplates (find the script) and CHAT (TextChatService vs legacy) so a neon gradient nickname can be applied in both.
(f) Any existing game pass / MarketplaceService usage, admin lists, and money API (Bank). Confirm no conflicting PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished handlers.
features.build:
Owner's decision (Korean chat): "1번 3번 4번만 기능 구현해줘 — 대화 판단해서 알잘딱". Passes (from a Gemini list):
#1 프리미엄 이동수단 및 '원격 차고(Remote Garage)' 패스 — hypercars/special vehicles permanently unlocked with Robux + summon your car anywhere with one button. The team agreed: WITHOUT the pass, car summoning works ONLY at the 정비소 (광안 오토 정비소 desk/area); the phone UI's vehicle features stay visible but LOCKED (🔒 with a '원격 차고 패스' purchase prompt); buying pass #1 unlocks phone summoning anywhere ('원격 차고') + the premium vehicle tier. Server must enforce the location rule (not just the UI). Add a clear in-world '차량 호출' station/prompt at the 정비소 for non-pass players.
#3 편의(QoL) 패스 — (i) 수감 및 부활 대기 시간 50% 단축 (jail time and KO/hospital wake-up/respawn waits halved, server-side), (ii) 스마트폰 '블랙마켓 앱': order ammo/방탄복 (the black-market NPC's items, same prices or config surcharge) remotely from the phone without visiting the NPC; delivered via the existing WeaponDealer purchase path (server-validated, rate-limited, money via the existing API); locked app shown to non-owners with a purchase prompt.
#4 과시 패스 — (i) KO 피니시 이펙트 팩: when the owner knocks out/kills someone, a selectable stylised effect plays over the victim/attacker for everyone nearby (e.g. 불꽃놀이, 해골 마크, 번개, 별 폭발, 돈다발 비) + custom sound + a short 'finisher' emote/pose for the attacker — stylised, NO gore/blood (Roblox policy; avoid the word '처형' in UI, use '피니시'); (ii) 차량 커스텀 번호판: owner types plate text (Korean plate format helper, e.g. '12가 3456' or free text up to 8 chars) filtered with TextService (FilterStringAsync → GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync; reject if filtering fails), saved, applied to all their cars' plates; (iii) 네온 닉네임: animated neon gradient on the overhead nameplate (BillboardGui + UIGradient, colour presets) and a gradient/coloured name in chat (TextChatService OnIncomingMessage PrefixText rich text; legacy chat fallback if used).
Common: GwangalliPassesShared Config with pass ids (0 = not configured → in Studio a config/attribute lets the owner simulate ownership for testing; in live servers unconfigured passes are hidden), names/descriptions/recommended Robux prices in Korean; ownership via MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync cached per player with retries + PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished for instant unlock (server re-verifies); a '패스 상점' UI (phone app + a shop button) with premium cards, perks list, buy buttons; locked-state UI everywhere relevant; settings UI for #4 (effect choice, plate text, nickname colours) saved via DataStore (retries + fallback). Public API in the shared/server module for other add-ons: Passes.has(player, 'garage'|'qol'|'flex'), Passes.changed signal — the dealership add-on (GwangalliCarDealer, being built in parallel) will use Passes.has(player,'garage') to gate the premium vehicle tier; if its files exist when you build, integrate directly; otherwise document the exact integration point in your answer. Korean UI, mobile-friendly, premium look.
